about.heroIntro: Explosive 420 Cannabis Social Club is a private wellness and lifestyle circle in Soshanguve Block L, connecting adult members with premium indoor flower from local growers.
founderParagraphs: Explosive 420 was built around a simple idea: quality cannabis belongs in a healthy, balanced routine. We connect premium indoor flower from local growers with adult members looking for an alternative approach to wellness and socialising.
Our menu focuses on premium indoor strains, starting at around R150 per gram, alongside dabs and extracts.
We are a community first. The club operates under South African private adult-use guidelines, and access is reserved for vetted adult members aged 21 and over.
